response.description:
Organizations
building AI agents often face a disconnect between where agents are built and
where business processes are automated. Now, with improved integration between
Azure AI Foundry and Azure Logic Apps, developers can now more easily
operationalize Foundry AI agents within enterprise workflows.  Azure AI
Foundry provides the platform where agents are built, grounded,
evaluated, and hosted using enterprise data, models, and tools. Azure
Logic Apps provides the orchestration layer where workflows, APIs, schedules,
and business events trigger and coordinate enterprise processes.  Together,
this enables developers to:  Invoke Foundry Hosted
Agents directly from Logic Apps workflows  Orchestrate agents
alongside APIs, connectors, and enterprise systems  Trigger AI-driven
workflows from business events or schedules  Run production-grade
agentic business processes with built-in observability and scale  This integration helps
organizations operationalize AI agents within real-world business automation
workflows.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure Logic Apps now enables developers to invoke Microsoft Foundry Agents directly from workflows.
